goal:
TOILET round, board side. Spec: docs/economy/2026-11-02-toilet-round-spec.md §B (B1-B5). Owner decisions T1-T4 are in the same spec.

WHY
Emission is built but its rules are not: free tiles earn, a cap is advertised that nothing enforces, the rate can move any amount at any time, and the caller chooses the token to mint on. These must be fixed before emission is switched on.

SCOPE (contracts/paid-board only, fresh init, no migration)
- B1: only credit-painted tiles earn. Add Holder.earning and total_earning; accrual uses them. Ownership counts (cells, total_cells, get_cells_owned) keep their meaning. Handle the same-artist free-to-credit repaint.
- B2: delete max_earning_cells from Tunables, defaults and validation. Do not touch quota_* (owner decision pending).
- B3: move toilet_per_cell_second to set_toilet_rate with the guards in the spec (x2 / /2, 24 h cooldown, 0 any time, bounded switch-on after 0, event, accrue first). set_tunables refuses a changed rate with RateViaSetter.
- B4: store the TOILET token id at new; claim_toilet() takes no argument; set_toilet_paused uses the stored id.
- B5: MIN_CLAIM constant (proposed 1 TOILET = 10^18), ClaimBelowMinimum.

ACCEPTANCE
- Every test named in spec §B tests; the first three must fail before the change.
- cargo test --locked green for paid-board and toilet; release wasm builds; cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings clean.
- contracts/paid-board/README.md updated: earning tiles, the rate setter and its guards, the stored token, the minimum claim.
- docs/learning/2026-11-xx-toilet-round-board.md with the failing tests and the boundaries.

DO NOT
- Do not change distribute_near, distribute_mpoo, set_staking_contract or anything in revenue.rs. The board's revenue path is unchanged by owner decision (T5).
- Do not touch contracts/toilet or the frontend.
- Do not deploy. Do not edit docs/backlog.md (put the status in the PR description).
